SELECT COUNT(*) FROM td_supply_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM td_trade_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_status IN ('DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(harvest_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(harvest_date), 2, '0')) AS ym, COALESCE(SUM(total_weight), 0) AS totalWeight FROM pt_harvest_batch WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_STORAGE') AND harvest_date >= DATEADD('MONTH', -5, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(harvest_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(harvest_date), 2, '0')) ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(trade_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(trade_date), 2, '0')) AS ym, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM td_trade_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND trade_date >= DATEADD('MONTH', -5, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(trade_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(trade_date), 2, '0')) ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT o.variety AS variety, COALESCE(SUM(h.total_weight), 0) AS totalWeight, COUNT(h.id) AS batchCount FROM pt_orchard o LEFT JOIN pt_harvest_batch h ON h.orchard_id = o.id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_STORAGE') WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.variety IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.variety ORDER BY totalWeight DESC

SELECT o.id AS orchardId, o.orchard_name AS orchardName, o.orchard_no AS orchardNo, o.variety AS variety, COALESCE(SUM(h.total_weight), 0) AS totalWeight FROM pt_orchard o LEFT JOIN pt_harvest_batch h ON h.orchard_id = o.id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_STORAGE') AND YEAR(h.harvest_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) WHERE o.deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.id, o.orchard_name, o.orchard_no, o.variety ORDER BY totalWeight DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT v.variety, COALESCE(s.supplyQty, 0) AS supplyQty, COALESCE(n.demandQty, 0) AS demandQty FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT variety FROM td_supply_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND variety IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT variety FROM td_purchase_need WHERE deleted = 0 AND variety IS NOT NULL ) v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT variety, SUM(quantity) AS supplyQty FROM td_supply_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY variety ) s ON s.variety = v.variety LEFT JOIN ( SELECT variety, SUM(quantity) AS demandQty FROM td_purchase_need WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY variety ) n ON n.variety = v.variety ORDER BY supplyQty DESC
SELECT current_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tr_trace_chain WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY current_status ORDER BY count DESC
